_comment: The transformation taxonomy (#2509 slice b): the verb vocabulary (each with a one-line hint of how that verb's invariants are typically checked), the composite RECIPES that generate transformation lists, and the composition tiers the bottom-up confirm queue orders by. ONE source of truth, embedded on both sides: crates/plandb/src/validate.rs (include_str! — the verb/recipe enums `bsc plan transformation` validates against) and the frontend (@data/transformations/taxonomy.json via overlayFile — verbMeta/tierLabel). recipes[].steps are the CANONICAL recipe playbooks: the Transformations stage prompt (src-tauri/data/stages/transformations.json) expands them into prose, and a drift test (planner/directives.rs recipe_playbooks_mirror_the_taxonomy_steps) pins the two in lockstep.

verbs.label: Rename
verbs.blurb: Change a name — symbol, file, route, concept — everywhere it appears; nothing else moves.
verbs.verification: grep finds zero references to the old name; the build and existing tests pass unchanged.

verbs.label: Extract
verbs.blurb: Pull a shared abstraction out of N similar implementations (or build a missing one) so the copies can point at it.
verbs.verification: the abstraction exists and builds; every planned consumer can express its case through it; existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Split
verbs.blurb: Break one oversized unit into focused parts along a seam (module, service, component).
verbs.verification: each part builds and is exercised independently; together they cover the original behavior — existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Merge
verbs.blurb: Combine overlapping units into one; the absorbed originals are deleted.
verbs.verification: the merged unit serves every former caller; grep finds no references to the absorbed originals; existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Move
verbs.blurb: Relocate a piece to where it belongs; every reference follows it.
verbs.verification: the piece lives at its new path with no stale-path references; behavior is unchanged — existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Replace
verbs.blurb: Swap an implementation for an equivalent — a kit component, a library, a pattern — at every usage site; the replaced original is deleted.
verbs.verification: every usage site renders/behaves through the replacement, the original is gone, and the stated invariants (handlers, focus, output) hold.

verbs.label: Upgrade
verbs.blurb: Raise a dependency, platform, or API to a newer version and absorb its breaking changes.
verbs.verification: the new version builds with no deprecation fallout left behind; the existing test suite passes unchanged.

verbs.label: Restyle
verbs.blurb: Change the look — styles, tokens, spacing — without changing structure or behavior.
verbs.verification: the diff is style-only: DOM structure, handlers, and behavior are unchanged; existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Remove
verbs.blurb: Delete something no longer needed, plus every reference to it.
verbs.verification: grep finds zero remaining references; the build and existing tests pass without it.

verbs.label: Optimize
verbs.blurb: Make the same behavior measurably faster or lighter — the contract does not change.
verbs.verification: the measured metric improves (before/after numbers recorded) while behavior is unchanged — existing tests pass.

verbs.label: Harden
verbs.blurb: Close a robustness or security gap — the failure mode becomes handled behavior.
verbs.verification: a test exercises the failure mode and now passes; existing tests still pass.

recipes.label: Migrate to kit
recipes.blurb: Scan the target frontend, match every component against the kit (whenUse/whenNot), and generate the migration list — gap-fill builds first, migrations in dependent waves.
steps: Enumerate the kit: components, whenUse/whenNot guidance, variants (bsc ui kit list · bsc ui list --full · bsc ui get <id> · bsc ui shapes)
Scan the linked frontend for components and usage sites (Glob/Grep); count usages per component
Bucket every finding: direct-mappable · mappable-with-adaptation · no-equivalent

No-equivalent clusters (>=2 similar bespoke implementations, or pages needing a missing Layout) become gap-fill rows: kitContribution true, verb extract, the tier of the thing being built, evidence = the bespoke instances with usage counts
Migration rows dependsOn their gap-fill builds
Assign tiers per the taxonomy (0 primitives -> 3 pages)
Write the whole list in ONE bsc plan transformation add batch

recipes.label: Extract & abstract
recipes.blurb: Find N similar bespoke implementations, build the shared abstraction once, then replace all N and delete the originals — foundation-first waves.
steps: Find the N similar bespoke implementations (Glob/Grep; record each with its usage count as evidence)
Record ONE extract row for the shared abstraction — the foundation, at the lower tier
Record N replace rows, one per original, each dependsOn the extract row
Fold delete-the-original into each replace row's delta (no separate remove rows)
Sequence foundation-first waves and write the whole list in one bsc plan transformation add batch

tiers.label: primitives
tiers.blurb: The most basic building blocks — buttons, fields, chips; nothing composes below them. Confirmed first.

tiers.label: composites
tiers.blurb: Assemblies of primitives — cards, form rows, toolbars — generated against confirmed primitives.

tiers.label: layouts
tiers.blurb: Page-structure templates composing composites — master-detail, split view, pane grid.

tiers.label: pages
tiers.blurb: Full screens assembled on the layouts — the top of the queue, confirmed last as the completed UI.
